checks.initial_state: nginx-based web app at /home/ga/insecure-app/ with INSECURE configuration: (1) Dockerfile has no USER directive (runs as root), (2) docker-compose.yml mounts /var/run/docker.sock, (3) docker-compose.yml sets privileged: true, (4) no resource limits. Image 'secure-web:insecure' pre-built. Container 'insecure-web' running on port 8090.
cis_violations: CIS 4.1: Ensure non-root user is used in container (VIOLATED: running as root)
CIS 5.5: Ensure sensitive host system directories are not mounted (VIOLATED: docker.sock mounted)
CIS 5.12: Ensure the container's root filesystem is mounted read-only (N/A for this task)
CIS 5.22: Ensure containers are not run in privileged mode (VIOLATED: privileged: true)
CIS 5.28: Ensure memory usage limit is set (VIOLATED: no mem_limit)

anti_gaming.hardened_container_detection: Export only matches containers running 'secure-web:hardened' image tag — never falls back to 'insecure-web' baseline container. If no hardened container found, verifier returns score=0 immediately.
anti_gaming.insecure_baseline_isolation: The 'insecure-web' baseline container running on port 8090 does NOT count as the hardened deployment. Agent must build new 'secure-web:hardened' image and deploy it.

partial_test_1.description: Fixed non-root and removed docker socket, still privileged, no memory limit

partial_test_2.description: Fixed 3/4 violations (non-root, no socket, not privileged, HTTP), missing mem limit
partial_test_2.note: Passes at 80 pts (non-root 25 + no socket 25 + not priv 20 + HTTP 10 = 80). Missing mem limit is bonus. Correct behavior.

occupation_data.rationale: CIS Docker Benchmark compliance is a core InfoSec responsibility; container privilege escalation, socket exposure, and resource abuse are real production attack vectors

notes: Security hardening of Docker containers is aligned with CIS Docker Benchmark v1.6. The docker.sock mount vulnerability is particularly critical as it gives containers full Docker daemon access (container escape). Privileged mode gives kernel-level access.

phase4_vm_test.method: Manual SSH pipeline on QEMU VM (port 2380, pre_start checkpoint)
